# netactuate_http_loadbalancer_groups (Data Source)

Reads HTTP Loadbalancer Groups visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_http_loadbalancer_groups" "example" {
  http_loadbalancer_id = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `http_loadbalancer_id` (Number) HTTP load balancer ID whose groups will be listed.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (List of Object) HTTP load balancer groups returned by the API. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--groups))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `groups`

Read-Only:

- `algorithm` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `http_group_id` (Number)
- `internal_port` (Number)
- `is_online` (Boolean)
- `match_address` (String)
- `match_ports` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `ssl_to_backend_enabled` (Boolean)
- `sticky_sessions_enabled` (Boolean)
